name: @accesslens/ai-gateway
description: AccessLens AWS model gateway: grounded Ask-this-class answers (Bedrock), reviewed-text speech (Polly), and live-caption stream authorization (Transcribe).

scripts.build: esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:@aws-sdk/* --loader:.json=json --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/chatHandler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/chat.mjs --loader:.json=json --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
